text.card: A red giant 3,482 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.82 solar masses and 8.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,623 K at its surface.
